slugline: EXT. JUDEAN HILLSIDE — DAY
title: A man had two sons
action: Listeners share bread; a scribe speaks quietly to a Pharisee at the edge; Jesus introduces two sons.
continuity: Living Jesus, no wounds; hillside is an invented telling location.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — UPPER TERRACE — LATE AFTERNOON
title: The work between them
action: Brothers set wall stone; basket repair; father and pack party arrive.
continuity: Long damaged wall. Younger repairs basket handle; elder exchanges sound basket.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD — LATE AFTERNOON
title: Two gifts
action: Father greets both sons, gives equal-quality mantles, washes elder’s cut.
continuity: Russet younger, olive elder. Split left palm; clean cloth dressing.

slugline: INT. FAMILY HOUSE — SUPPER ROOM — EVENING
title: The request
action: Shared supper breaks under inheritance request; father agrees to divide between both sons.
continuity: Bread crumbles; meal untouched. Both sons receive bread.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD ENTRANCE — NIGHT
title: Brothers at the gate
action: Brothers sit apart at threshold; elder gives repaired waterskin; father remains inside.
continuity: Russet worn; waterskin seam established; one lamp out.

slugline: INT. FAMILY HOUSE — STORE ROOM — DAY
title: The division
action: Document and silver division, packing, basket sorting and father/elder boundary walk.
continuity: No new valuation; both shares visible; portable bundles transferred over days.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — ROAD — DAWN
title: Leaving
action: Departure packing and embrace; younger leaves with carriers; father and elder stand together.
continuity: Bread cloth, bedding, money and repaired waterskin depart with younger.

slugline: EXT. ROADS BEYOND JUDEA — DAYS
title: The wider world
action: Road, cistern, fork; carrier receives generous coin; title over landscape.
continuity: Same donkey/carriers; broad road toward town; russet still worn.

slugline: EXT. FOREIGN TOWN — MARKET STREET — DAY
title: A place at the table
action: Damon advises garment, bread bought generously, companions make a place.
continuity: Blue-border mantle selected; russet still on younger at arrival.

slugline: INT. FOREIGN TOWN — RENTED ROOM AND BANQUET COURT — NIGHT
title: The cost of being welcomed
action: Paid banquet and dance; wine spills; younger retrieves waterskin alone.
continuity: Russet on room peg; blue worn and wine-stained; waterskin recovered.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD AND TERRACE — EVENING
title: The son who remains
action: Father follows elder to wall with meal and olive mantle.
continuity: Partly repaired wall, healing left palm, traveler passes entrance.

slugline: INT. FOREIGN TOWN — LODGING AND STREET — DAYS
title: The last silver
action: Coins dwindle; russet sold; host refuses more bread; younger takes bedding away.
continuity: Two small final coins; blue mantle retained and worn; russet exits permanently.

slugline: EXT. FOREIGN TOWN — MARKET AND OUTSKIRTS — DAYS
title: Hunger
action: Depleted market, failed field, displacement and denied work; farmer offers pig-feed labor.
continuity: Famine after spending; Damon also hungry; blue returned by bread seller.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — CISTERN AND STORE — DAY
title: What duty has become
action: Cistern load reopens palm; father washes hand; basket failure prompts rebuke and apology.
continuity: Left-hand blood; old basket knot loosens; elder gathers grain and offers to mend.

slugline: EXT. FOREIGN FARM — PIG ENCLOSURE — DAY INTO NIGHT
title: Coming to himself
action: Pigs eat pods; younger fails to take feed, finds empty bread cloth, remembers home, rehearses confession and leaves.
continuity: Memory reuses S2/S4 exactly; blue mantle and waterskin retrieved; feed basket left at gate; personal bundle retained.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — UPPER TERRACE — MID-AFTERNOON
title: The unfinished course
action: Father brings food and olive mantle to nearly complete wall; elder resumes work. Later he collects small stones on far side of terrace, beyond ordinary path sightline.
continuity: Short unfinished run. Left-palm scar; pale cuff mend.

slugline: EXT. ROAD TOWARD THE FAMILY FARM — DAY
story_time: Return journey ending on homecoming day
title: The way back
action: Blue mantle traded for food; sandals fail and are left; younger retraces fork and approaches home.
continuity: Repaired waterskin and empty bread cloth retained. Bare feet after discard.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD ENTRANCE AND ROAD — MID-AFTERNOON
title: The father runs
action: Father recognizes, runs, embraces and kisses; confession; robe/ring/sandals requested.
continuity: Younger barefoot/ragged. Bundle set down. Dust transfers to father.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD — MID-AFTERNOON INTO DUSK
story_time: Homecoming day with several hours compressed
title: Restored to the house
action: Feet washed; robe/ring/sandals fitted; several hours of jointed calf preparation compressed; neighbors arrive; Levi sent near start of meal.
continuity: Right-hand ring, new sandals, worn tunic under robe. Preparation time compressed.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — FIELD PATH AND COURTYARD ENTRANCE — DUSK
title: Outside the feast
action: Elder returns with empty bowl and olive mantle; Levi tells him; he stops outside feast.
continuity: Olive carried; left scar pressed; bowl set beside threshold; feast continuous.

slugline: INT./EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD AND ENTRANCE — NIGHT
title: The father comes out
action: Father leaves courtyard and hears elder’s grievance; affirms him and renews invitation.
continuity: Father dusty; elder retains mantle; empty bowl at threshold; younger still wasted.

slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — THRESHOLD — NIGHT
title: The invitation remains
action: Younger starts to stand; elder’s grip loosens; father leaves doorway clear.
continuity: No crossing shown; invitation unresolved; positions continue from S21.

slugline: END CREDITS OVER BLACK
title: End credits
action: Readable credits over black with final audio coda.
continuity: Typography composited in finishing; no images generated for credits.
